items.exampleEn: The new phones are on display in the window.
Our teacher showed us twenty slides about Japan.
items.exampleZh: 老師給我們看了二十張關於日本的投影片。

items.exampleEn: My breakfast consists of eggs and toast.
The road bends to the left here.
There is a small passage behind the kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 廚房後面有一條小通道。

items.exampleEn: Before we moved, it took us a whole week to pack.
items.exampleZh: 搬家前，我們花了整整一週打包。

items.sentenceEn: Sorry to bother you, but can I ask a question?
items.sentenceZh: 抱歉打擾一下，我可以問個問題嗎？

items.audioEn: The kids are playing on the slide in the park.
items.audioZh: 孩子們在公園裡玩溜滑梯。

items.sentenceEn: She bent down to pick up the coin.
items.sentenceZh: 她彎下腰撿起那枚硬幣。

items.sentenceEn: Don't forget to pack your toothbrush.
items.sentenceZh: 別忘了把牙刷打包進去。

items.stemEn: Read the ____ and answer the questions below.
items.stemZh: 閱讀這段文章並回答下面的問題。
這份考試由三個部分組成。

items.passageEn: Last week, our class visited a museum. The trip consisted of two parts. First, we saw a display of old toys, like a small wooden slide for dolls. Then we walked through a long, dark passage to a room full of old maps. One door was very low, so we had to bend down. Before we left, we asked a guard many questions. "Sorry to bother you," our teacher said to him. At the end of the visit, we packed our notes in our bags.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們班去參觀博物館。這趟參觀分成兩個部分。首先，我們看了一個老玩具展，像是給洋娃娃玩的小木頭溜滑梯。接著，我們穿過一條又長又暗的通道，來到一個擺滿老地圖的房間。有一扇門很低，我們得彎下腰才能通過。離開前，我們問了警衛很多問題，老師對他說：「抱歉打擾您了。」最後，我們把筆記收進包包裡。

questions.questionZh: 這趟參觀分成幾個部分？
第一部分他們看了什麼？

referenceEn: I haven't packed my bag yet.
I haven't packed my suitcase yet.
The hot weather doesn't bother me.
rubricZh: 用 bother 表示「使困擾」（例如 doesn't bother me）
否定配合主詞（例如 Hot weather doesn't bother me、Hot days don't bother me 等）
